# Sub-Portal Governance: `tools/third_party/` (`AGENTS.md`)

This guide governs all content under `docs/content/user/tools/third_party/`.

---

## 🧭 Subdirectory Purpose & Scope
Houses tutorial units and helper modules that facilitate zero-friction bridges and interoperability with third-party packages (such as NGLView and OpenMM).

## 📄 Pages List & Paired Micro-`AGENTS.md` Files
- `index.md` ➔ `index.AGENTS.md`: Index portal with 2-column package catalog table and hidden `toctree`.
